title: Galton Board
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Galton
learningObjectives: Trace a single ball released by the New Ball button as it makes six independent left-or-right decisions, each with 50% probability
Explain why the count of balls landing in each bin approximates a binomial distribution over six trials
Predict which bin is most likely to receive a ball and calculate its probability from the number of distinct paths leading to it
Compare the histogram after 10 balls with the histogram after several hundred balls to describe how sampling variation shrinks
Distinguish the random path of one ball from the predictable bell-shaped pattern of many balls
